note: Majority: Family Law of Kosovo (Law No. 2004/32), Article 15, read in the Official Gazette's text on gzk.rks-gov.net: majority is reached on turning 18, and full capacity to act comes with majority or with marriage before it (a court may allow marriage from 16), which the form doesn't hold. A newer Civil Code, if one has come into force, wasn't looked for. Work: Law No. 03/L-212 on Labour (Official Gazette No. 90, 1 December 2010), Article 7: an employment relationship may be formed with any person from 18, and with persons of 15 to 18 for light work that doesn't endanger their health or development; no employer may conclude an employment contract with a person under 15. The article makes no exception for performers or artistic work, so a performer under 15 is read as barred (a reading, not the law's word); the Ministry's Administrative Instruction No. 01/2012 on light and prohibited work for persons under 18 wasn't read. Service: not read. No law calling anyone to military service was found; the Kosovo Security Force's law wasn't reached (the Gazette's search runs by form postback, not followed today), so service is left null rather than set to none without a source.

sources.said: (2) Mosha madhore fitohet me të mbushur 18 vjet. (3) Aftësia e plotë për të vepruar fitohet me arritjen e moshës madhore dhe me lidhjen e martesës para arritjes së kësaj moshe.

sources.title: Gazeta Zyrtare Nr. 90, 01 dhjetor 2010, Ligji Nr. 03/L-212 i Punës
sources.said: 1. Marrëdhënia e punës mund të themelohet me çdo person prej moshës tetëmbëdhjetë (18) vjeç. ... 2. Marrëdhënia e punës mund të themelohet edhe me personat në mes të moshës pesëmbëdhjetë (15) deri në tetëmbëdhjetë (18) vjeç, të cilët mund të punësohen për punë të lehta ... 3. Asnjë punëdhënës nuk mund të lidhë kontratë pune me ndonjë person nën moshën pesëmbëdhjetë (15) vjeç.
